t_advice_summary_textbox.text: gnomes can have high or low values ranging from 0-9. they are split into two groups. one group will start off with low values and increase as the rounds progress and the other group will start off with high values and decrease as the rounds progress.

vb_textbox.text: Every gnome has a different value 0-9 based on their colour. It seems that group 1 (red, blue, pink, purple) have similar values and group 2 (brown, yellow, orange, green) have similar values. One group will start with higher values and go down whilst the other group starts with lower values and increases. For example, group 1 starts with high values and group 2 with low values. After so many rounds, group 1 will then have low values and group 1 high. This fluctuates during the game.
